name: Ihor Lazarkov

about_me.summary: Senior SDET with 18 years designing and scaling test automation across financial, telecom, and SaaS organizations — from frameworks adopted across entire client engagements to test architectures rolled out team-wide. Pursuing the next step into a dedicated Test/Automation Architect role, backed by hands-on full-stack and AI-tooling experience.

notable_accomplishments: Served as client-facing technical lead at Edward Jones, achieving a 95% satisfaction rate from business partners.
Architected a POC automation tool at Edward Jones (Java, JavaEE, Spring Boot, Hibernate) that became the foundation of the team's automation framework.
Redesigned Edward Jones' legacy automation framework with custom adapters for DB/EMS message validation — **60% faster execution**, **50% more reliable**.
Designed and rolled out a new test automation architecture at Comcast within the first two weeks — **60% faster execution**, adopted by a team of 20 engineers.
Diagnosed an inverted test pyramid at Comcast that was inflating defects and slowing delivery; findings were adopted into the engineering roadmap.
Designed a cross-project automation framework at EPAM used to validate databases and messages across all client projects — **4x faster test execution**.
Prevented several critical defects from reaching production at Cisco Meraki by establishing quality gates, protecting the company's reputation.

experience.title: SDET IV
experience.description: Contributed to test automation with high-quality code and testing insights provided to project management during a critical company-wide migration from legacy CRM to a proprietary platform.
contributions: Designed and implemented a new test automation architecture within the first two weeks, reducing test execution time by up to 60%, then trained a team of 20 engineers to adopt it across their projects.
Architected and maintained an AI engineering harness (skills, context management, sub-agents), accelerating automated code generation while retaining strict review and architectural oversight.

Assessed the existing automation framework and application codebase — architecture, design, and unit/component test coverage — identifying an inverted test pyramid with excessive E2E coverage and root-causing multiple defects, including a race condition surfaced during automated test entry; findings quantified the cost to the business and were adopted into the team's roadmap, with remediation scheduled following the current release.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer, Testing
experience.description: Worked as Senior Software Engineer in Test in a team of 6 engineers. Responsible for delivering software for automation testing of functional and integration tests with seamless CI/CD integration. Collaborated with product owners to understand functionality, demo completed work, gather feedback, and deliver continuous improvements.
contributions: Served as client-facing technical lead for the automation framework: negotiated testing requirements directly with stakeholders, and presented test coverage and release-readiness reports to leadership — driving framework design decisions without formal direct reports, and achieving a 95% satisfaction rate from business partners.
Architected, designed, and implemented a POC automation tool using Java Core, JavaEE, Spring Boot, and Hibernate for ELT testing, laying the foundation for the team's future automation framework.

Drastically improved a legacy automation framework for a distributed-services application by designing and implementing adapters to validate database state persistence and EMS messages, resulting in a 60% decrease in automation execution time and a 50% reliability improvement.
Improved performance in existing and new automation test cases by up to 60%.
Supported engineers in troubleshooting technical issues and coached the team on best practices for handling failed assertions and fallbacks to keep test data idempotent.
Implemented a POC that served as the base for another team to build a project with a reusable API library.
Identified and fixed false-positive tests.

Contributed to test automation software by developing architectural solutions and applying OOP principles (e.g., polymorphism, inheritance, encapsulation) and design patterns (e.g., Builder, Singleton, Factory, Strategy, Facade), decoupling implementation details via abstract methods, interfaces, and functional interfaces.

Performed thorough code analysis of a transitioned project through debugging, test execution, refactoring, and codebase ownership, achieving stability improvements, reducing duplicated code by ~1,800 lines, and cutting test execution time by up to 40%.
Developed reliable web test automation solutions for highly complex UI features through thorough analysis of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript using browser Developer Tools.

Designed test scenarios in Gherkin using parameterizable instructions, DataTables, and Scenario Outlines for reusability, maximum readability for non-technical stakeholders, and complete technical detail to serve as a single source of truth.
Developed and organized cucumber glue code on a per-page and per-functionality basis to establish clear ownership, eliminate code duplication, and improve maintainability.

experience.title: Full Stack Software Engineer (Part-Time)
experience.description: Worked part-time as a Software Engineer, concurrent with full-time role at Edward Jones, in an Agile environment with two other engineers to design and implement marketing SaaS applications.
contributions: Delivered features with near-zero defect return rates by applying software design best practices.
Developed test harnesses across unit, integration, and system levels, ensuring high confidence in software reliability.
Implemented reusable, complex UI components (e.g., accordions, filterable lists, tabs) using JSX, JSON parameterization, React hooks (useState, useRef, useContext, useReducer), and modular CSS.
Debugged and fixed 10+ complex issues, performing root-cause analysis using browser DevTools and React DevTools.

experience.title: Software Engineer (open-source contributor), Front End
experience.description: Contributed as a Software Engineer to an open-source project with an international team, building standardized UI components across Layer5 projects.
contributions: Gained domain expertise in the existing JSX/TSX/CSS codebase by analyzing requirements, unit tests, and existing architecture.
Implemented features using appropriate data structures (Map, Set, List) and design patterns (Singleton, Builder, Factory) to ensure a maintainable and scalable codebase.
Audited the codebase for media queries and ARIA attributes to ensure strict adherence to responsive web design and accessibility (a11y) standards.
Debugged issues and conducted code analysis to deepen understanding of project architecture.
Resolved bugs by writing clean, well-documented TypeScript code using explicit types, interfaces, and enums.
Managed code contributions via Git, regularly merging updates and submitting well-documented pull requests.
Participated in community meetings, collaborated on architectural changes, and presented completed work.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer, Testing
experience.description: Worked as a Senior Software Engineer in Test in a team of 5. Developed software for functional, E2E, and API testing using in-house and modern automation test frameworks. Led test planning, design, and established quality standards.
contributions: Successfully executed a multi-phase test plan during a major business model transformation, ensuring all quality KPIs were met.
Developed front-end and back-end functional and integration test frameworks from scratch.
Integrated automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines with real-time Slack reporting.
Established automated quality gates for CI/CD pipelines, preventing multiple critical defects from reaching production and eliminating unnecessary context switching for development teams.
Fostered effective team communication by establishing structured meeting agendas and clear action items.

experience.title: Senior Automation Test Engineer
experience.description: Worked in a fast-paced Agile environment across multiple complex client projects. Developed testing standards and strategies, defined test scope, and collaborated with technical leads and product owners. Designed and implemented Java-based automation and performance testing frameworks (Selenium, Cucumber, FitNesse, TestNG, RestAssured, JMeter) for web applications and RESTful APIs.
contributions: Designed a cross-project automation framework to validate databases and messaging queues, resulting in 4x faster test execution, reduced support overhead, and enhanced quality visibility.
Expanded test coverage and capabilities by modernizing legacy automation systems, significantly improving readability, maintainability, and execution speed.
Reduced regression execution time and enabled continuous software stability monitoring by engineering new Gradle build tasks and integrating automation frameworks into CI/CD pipelines.

Architected scalable test frameworks, reusable libraries, and custom plugins from scratch for front-end, back-end, and RESTful API testing using Cucumber, Selenium WebDriver, RestAssured, OOP principles, and Java design patterns.
Built custom internal web tools (Spring Boot MVC, JavaScript, HTML/CSS) for QA environment health monitoring and test data setup, accelerating test preparation and failure triage.

testimonial.author: Sonum Matur
testimonial.title: Software Engineering Manager @ Cisco Meraki
testimonial.content: Ihor is a very sincere and dedicated SDET Engineer. His clarity and concepts of test automation to cover the quality of the product was impressive. He preached the test automation pyramid while we worked together at Meraki and was also instrumental in right execution for the product quality. Ihor is a quick and ambitious learner and always wanted to explore more and more of knowledge and skill set.

testimonial.author: Venkat Gunji
testimonial.title: Founder & CEO of LVC Solutions
testimonial.content: I had the pleasure of working with Ihor and was consistently impressed by his technical expertise, professionalism, and collaborative approach. He brings strong problem-solving skills, a deep understanding of software development, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results. Ihor is someone who takes ownership of his work, communicates effectively, and is always willing to support the team when needed. His ability to tackle complex challenges and turn ideas into practical solutions makes him a valuable asset to any organization. Beyond his technical skills, Ihor is a great team player who fosters a positive and productive working environment. I highly recommend him to any company looking for a skilled, reliable, and dedicated engineering professional.
